stakeholder_examples.overview: Complete workflow examples demonstrating the BobKit-Stakeholder mode in action, from initial validation through remediation and PR creation.

example.name: complete_validation_workflow
example.scenario: User has completed implementation and wants comprehensive validation before creating a pull request.

step.tool_use:
<execute_command> <command>scripts/bash/check-prerequisites.sh --json --require-tasks --include-tasks</command> </execute_command>
# Parse JSON output: # FEATURE_DIR: specs/user-authentication/ # AVAILABLE_DOCS: [spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, data-model.md, contracts/]

<execute_command> <command>git status --porcelain</command> </execute_command>
# Output shows: # M src/auth/middleware.py # M src/api/users.py # A src/models/user.py # M tests/test_auth.py

findings.critical: - Hardcoded API key in src/auth/middleware.py:45 - Missing authentication on /api/users endpoint (constitution violation)
findings.high: - No error handling in src/api/users.py:120-135 - Test coverage only 65% (constitution requires 80%)
findings.medium: - Inconsistent naming: getUserData vs get_user_profile - Missing docstrings in src/models/user.py
findings.positive: - Well-structured authentication middleware - Comprehensive input validation

step.action: Present findings and get user decision
step.tool_use: <ask_followup_question> <question>Critical/high-priority issues detected that should be resolved before proceeding. Would you like me to:</question> <follow_up> <suggest mode="bobkit-engineer">Update tasks.md and switch to Engineer mode to fix them</suggest> <suggest>Document them in findings.md and proceed anyway (not recommended)</suggest> </follow_up> </ask_followup_question>

step.action: User chooses option A - fix issues
step.tool_use:
<write_to_file> <path>specs/user-authentication/tasks.md</path> <content> [Existing tasks...]
## Remediation Tasks
- [ ] [REMED-001] [CRITICAL] Remove hardcoded API key from src/auth/middleware.py:45 and use environment variable - [ ] [REMED-002] [CRITICAL] Add authentication middleware to /api/users endpoint in src/api/users.py - [ ] [REMED-003] [HIGH] Add try-catch error handling to src/api/users.py:120-135 - [ ] [REMED-004] [HIGH] Increase test coverage to 80% by adding tests for edge cases - [ ] [REMED-005] [MEDIUM] Standardize naming convention (use snake_case throughout) - [ ] [REMED-006] [MEDIUM] Add docstrings to all functions in src/models/user.py
<!-- Made with Bob -->
User requests validation with --create-findings-file flag to document issues for later review rather than immediate fixes. </scenario>
<user_request> Run /bobkit.check --create-findings-file </user_request>
<workflow> <step number="1-4"> <action>Same initialization and validation as previous example</action> </step>
<step number="5"> <action>Present findings and get user decision</action> <tool_use><![CDATA[ <ask_followup_question> <question>Medium/low-priority issues detected. Would you like me to:</question> <follow_up> <suggest mode="bobkit-engineer">Update tasks.md and switch to Engineer mode to fix them</suggest> <suggest>Document them in findings.md for later review</suggest> <suggest>Proceed as is (issues noted but not blocking)</suggest> </follow_up> </ask_followup_question>

step.action: User chooses option B - document in findings.md
step.tool_use:
<write_to_file> <path>findings.md</path> <content> # Code Review Findings
## Summary Comprehensive validation completed for user-authentication feature. - Total issues: 6 - Critical: 0 - High: 0 - Medium: 4 - Low: 2
## Medium Priority Issues
### Inconsistent Naming Convention - **Location**: src/api/users.py:45, src/models/user.py:23 - **Description**: Mixed use of camelCase and snake_case for function names - **Impact**: Reduces code readability and maintainability - **Mitigation**: Standardize on snake_case throughout Python codebase
### Missing Docstrings - **Location**: src/models/user.py (multiple functions) - **Description**: Public functions lack docstrings - **Impact**: Harder for other developers to understand API - **Mitigation**: Add docstrings following Google style guide
### Code Duplication - **Location**: src/api/users.py:120-135, src/api/admin.py:89-104 - **Description**: Similar validation logic duplicated - **Impact**: Maintenance burden, potential for inconsistency - **Mitigation**: Extract to shared validation utility function
### Missing Type Hints - **Location**: src/models/user.py (multiple functions) - **Description**: Function parameters lack type hints - **Impact**: Reduced IDE support and type safety - **Mitigation**: Add type hints to all function signatures
## Low Priority Issues
### TODO Comments - **Location**: src/auth/middleware.py:78 - **Description**: TODO comment about optimization - **Impact**: Minor - optimization is not critical - **Mitigation**: Either implement optimization or remove comment
### Unused Import - **Location**: src/api/users.py:5 - **Description**: Import of 'datetime' module not used - **Impact**: Minimal - slightly larger module size - **Mitigation**: Remove unused import
## Positive Findings - Well-structured authentication middleware with clear separation of concerns - Comprehensive input validation prevents common security issues - Good test coverage for happy path scenarios - Clear error messages for user-facing errors
